characters.name: Ceira Blackthorn
characters.note: Full design in session logs 2026-10-07. 9 quests: SQ-C1 to SQ-C6 (personal) + SI-C1 to SI-C9 (interaction). Arc spans Acts 2-6.

quests.name: The Confession She Carried Out
quests.desc: She mentions in passing that she has been confessing increasingly specific dreams to a confessor for three years. First time she has said this to anyone who is not a priest. She seems unaware this is unusual.

quests.name: The Wound She Notices First
quests.pre: Her hands have been stopping in the middle of tasks around him. She has been putting them back in motion.
quests.scene: She treats his injury. Her hands linger past the point of need. He does not move. She examines the wound again — already clean. She does this twice. She says: 'It is healing correctly.' She does not let go.
quests.post: She is precisely, unusually professional for the rest of the day. She hums something she does not know she is humming. She hums it again the next morning.

quests.name: What They Never Taught
quests.desc: She asks a question about the outside world that reveals the full extent of her cloistered education. The question is completely innocent. What she does with the answer is not.

quests.name: The Dream She Describes Out Loud
quests.pre: She has been looking at him with something closer to recognition than shyness for a week.
quests.scene: Unprompted, during a quiet moment, she starts describing one of the dreams framed as a theological question. Within three sentences it is clearly not. She does not stop mid-description — she finishes it. 'I was not going to say that.' Pause. 'I said it anyway.'
quests.post: She finds him within the hour and asks if it bothered him. The answer changes something in her posture. She stands more settled.

quests.name: Being Watched
quests.pre: She has been aware he is watching her work. She has been adjusting nothing. She has been aware that she has been adjusting nothing.
quests.scene: He tells her he was watching. Not as a confession — as a statement of fact. He describes what he saw, specifically. She is very still for a long time. The flush is not embarrassment. She says: 'You should have said.' He says: 'I am saying now.' She does not move away.
quests.post: She asks him to watch again. Specifically. She phrases it as a practical request. She does not look at him while he watches. Everything she does knows he is there.

quests.name: The Patient She Remembered
quests.desc: A patient from her sickroom years — someone whose suffering she recognised but could not treat because she lacked knowledge she now has. The suffering was this kind of suffering. She made the connection recently.

quests.name: Permission
quests.pre: She has been carrying a specific question for years, framing it as theological. She has been wrong about what kind of question it is.
quests.scene: He gives her permission — not for a specific act but to want what she wants without confession afterward. He says it simply. She receives it in complete silence. Then: 'I would like to.' He waits. She says: 'Everything.' She means this in the least vague way possible.
quests.post: She goes to write something in her prayer journal. She closes it after one line. She gives the journal to him. 'I will not need it anymore.' She is not leaving faith. She is finished confessing what she now knows is not a sin.

quests.name: What She Was Dreaming
quests.pre: She has been compiling the specific content of the dreams and cross-referencing them with what she now knows. She has been shockingly accurate in her dreaming.
quests.scene: Extended intimacy built on SURRENDER first (she needs safety), then VANILLA (safety gives way to fullness), then EXHIBITIONIST (she wants to see herself seen), then VOYEUR elements as the scene progresses. The scene is the dreams made real. Partway through: 'That is — yes, that is what I was dreaming.' She has always known exactly what she wanted. She just did not know it was allowed.
quests.post: She sleeps through the night for the first time in three years. In the morning: 'I have to revise something I told my confessor.' Pause. 'Several things.' She smiles at something. She does not explain it.

quests.name: What Mercy Is
quests.desc: She redefines her calling — not by abandoning it but by expanding it. She is still going back to the sick. What she is bringing has changed. She is better at reaching the specific kind of suffering she could not reach before.

quests.name: The Open Hand's New Mercy
quests.pre: Days after SI-N5. She is working. The patients get everything she always gave them plus something additional — she is more present.
quests.scene: She comes to him with a realisation: she is better at her calling now. Not because she was corrupted — because she was completed. She says this without drama. Then she tells him the last thing she is going to tell her confessor — an accounting of everything, in full, to release it from that frame. She tells him the confession before she gives it. It takes a while.
quests.post: She returns from the confessor. 'He cried.' Pause. 'I think he has been carrying something too.' She is still herself. She is just no longer missing anything.

characters.name: Maea Hollowtide
characters.note: FREEZE resistance — shame is the only gate. The arc is not conquest but presence: staying present long enough that shame runs out of room.

quests.name: The Baths Before Him
quests.desc: How the baths were before she married. Her mother's baths. That she knew what this place was before he made it a business. It is hers in the original sense.

quests.name: The Guest Who Looks
quests.pre: She has had guests for fifteen years. None of them have looked at her the way that requires a response. She has been responding to him with internal equipment she had filed away.
quests.scene: He looks at her. Not at the towels or the establishment — at her, specifically. He says: 'The baths are excellent.' Then: 'So is this.' He means her. She freezes. Her hands keep moving. They stop being useful. He does not move or explain. He waits. She says: 'Thank you.' It takes a while to say. She means something she has never meant when she said it.
quests.post: She spends fourteen minutes in a room that does not need checking. When she comes out she has herself assembled correctly. She gives him the best room.

quests.name: What He Never Said
quests.desc: Not angry, not bitter — she describes specifically what her husband never said. That he used her like a utility and she was grateful to be useful. That she knows now what was missing.

quests.name: What She Deserves
quests.pre: She has been carrying shame about her body — the way it draws attention she did not invite. He has been looking at her as though she deserves to be looked at. She does not know what to do with this.
quests.scene: She is in the main bath at closing, alone or thinking she is. She starts to cover herself — old habit. He says: 'Don't.' Not demanding. Simple. She stops. He says: 'You are worth looking at.' She stands there. He says it again. The shame is still there but it is fighting for space against something new.
quests.post: She does not cover herself when she walks through the back corridor later. One step. She notes this.

quests.name: Her Body's Opinion
quests.desc: She has been ashamed of her body her entire marriage. The body was never wrong. She is slowly reaching this conclusion. She says this half-aloud while cleaning a room. She sees him and goes quiet.

quests.name: Told Out Loud
quests.pre: She has been cataloguing every time he has said something specific about her — not the baths, her. She has three instances. She has been going over them.
quests.scene: He finds her in the garden. He tells her what he wants from her specifically — not services, her. He is direct about this. She freezes. He waits. She defreezes slowly. SUBMISSIVE lean — she gives what she has been keeping packed away. He names everything he takes. Each thing named is the wound healed.
quests.post: She sits in the garden afterward and does an inventory. At the end: 'I am still here.' She means: the shame is less than the space it used to fill.

quests.name: The MASOCHIST Lean
quests.pre: Her husband was rough by default. She never identified this as a preference. It was just how it was. She has been revisiting this with different data.
quests.scene: He is rough because she wants him to be, not because he is not thinking about her. This distinction is enormous. MASOCHIST lean activating: the roughness with intention and the saying-so behind it is different from the roughness without. She is told she is wanted, loudly, throughout. The shame runs out of room entirely.
quests.post: 'He never said it.' Long pause. 'You said it every time.' She means this as an accounting of the difference, not a complaint about her husband.

quests.name: Room at the Top
quests.pre: She has been running the baths differently. Not the schedule — the feeling of it. She is still precise and correct and warm with guests. She is also present in a way she was not before.
quests.scene: She shows him the room she has kept locked for three years — the one she furnished and then could not bear to use. She unlocks it. It was always going to be used like this.
quests.post: She goes downstairs and starts the morning fires. Normal. Correct. At the top of the stairs: 'You can stay.' She means the room. She means more than the room.

quests.name: The Baths As Hers
quests.desc: Post-fall: she makes one change to the baths that her husband would have considered unnecessary. It makes the establishment more hers. She is the only one who knows what it means.

quests.name: The Guest Register She Knows By Heart
quests.desc: Eight years of watching people come and go. The ones she remembered. Why. That she has been waiting for a category she could not name.

quests.name: Eager and Flustered
quests.pre: She has been blushing about him for a week with increasing specificity.
quests.scene: He notices something specific she did well — really notices, details it. She goes scarlet. She says thank you twice. She drops something.
quests.post: She replays the specific thing he said for the rest of the day.

quests.name: The Guilt That Comes After
quests.pre: She has been in her head about the specific fantasies — the rough, the degradation, the forbidden.
quests.scene: He does one specific thing she has been fantasising about and she complies instantly and without strategy.
quests.post: The guilt comes after. She comes back anyway.

quests.name: Used and Loved For It
quests.pre: She has been trying to reconcile wanting to be used and wanting to be loved.
quests.scene: She finds out they are not opposed. Extended intimacy — SUBMISSIVE/MASOCHIST/DEGRADATION. He uses her and tells her she is worth it throughout.
quests.post: She makes him food. The specific dish she saves for people she loves.

quests.name: Deserves It
quests.pre: She has been told she does not deserve the specific things she wants.
quests.scene: He tells her she does. She argues reflexively. He continues. BONDAGE lean activating — the argument stops when she cannot move.
quests.post: 'Oh.'

quests.name: What She Cooks For
quests.desc: She makes a new recipe she invented and names it something private that only the two of them would understand. He asks. She explains it.

quests.name: The Books She Keeps
quests.desc: The specific books that pass through the baths from travelers. The one she could not return. What it described. That she read it twice.

quests.name: Not Looking Away
quests.pre: She has been moving into his orbit and staying there without requiring anything. Two weeks of this.
quests.scene: He looks at her and does not look away. She freezes. He keeps not looking away. She takes the longest time. She does not freeze forever.
quests.post: She stays near. Not closer. Near.

quests.name: The Dream She Read About
quests.desc: The book. She describes the specific section. She does not realise she is describing what she wants. She realises mid-sentence. She keeps going.

quests.name: Wanted Completely
quests.pre: Guests notice her body. He notices her.
quests.scene: He says specifically what he notices about her that is not her figure. She has no response architecture for this. She tries several.
quests.post: She makes one error in the accounts that evening that she does not catch until morning.

quests.name: Patient Enough
quests.pre: She has been wanting someone patient enough to be her first and not leave.
quests.scene: He is patient. First time. VANILLA as frame — slow, her pace entirely. He does not rush. She gives completely, piece by piece, at her pace.
quests.post: 'You did not rush.' She sounds like this was unexpected.

quests.name: Teaching
quests.pre: She has been learning.
quests.scene: Extended intimacy — SUBMISSIVE/SURRENDER fully active. She is taught. She absorbs everything with the precision she applies to accounts. She is completely present. She has questions. She asks them. He answers.
quests.post: She has questions. She asks them. He answers. She takes notes in her head.

quests.name: Entirely His
quests.pre: She has been reading the book for the third time.
quests.scene: She gives herself entirely, as she described it — to that person, not looking away.
quests.post: 'I gave myself entirely to someone.' She sounds like someone confirming a calculation. 'It was correct.'
